tasks.label: File IO - build and run
args: set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p "${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output"; g++ -g "${file}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out"; clear; timeout 10s /usr/bin/time -v --output "${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output/sys.txt" "${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out" < "${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output/input.txt" > "${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output/output.txt" 2>>"${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output/run_stderr.txt" || true; rm -f "${workspaceFolder}/Striver_sheet/output/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.out";
tasks.detail: Compile current file and run with stdin from Striver_sheet/output/input.txt
